$comment: Advisories the TS SDK's dev toolchain knowingly ships with, read by audit-gate.mjs
from the scheduled audit (.github/workflows/audit.yml). Empty is the goal state. As of
2026-11-02 the single entry below is devDependency-only (eslint/typescript-eslint chain)
and has no fixed release reachable without a major the dependents do not accept.
Nothing here ships in the published package.
Add an entry ONLY when the fix is genuinely unreachable. Prefer, in order: drop the
dependency, bump it, or add a scoped `overrides` entry in package.json. Scope every entry
with `paths` so the exception cannot silently widen to a different install location.
Fields: advisory (GHSA id), package, paths (exact npm-audit node paths), reason (why it is
not fixable and why the residual risk is acceptable), revisitBy (YYYY-MM-DD; the gate
FAILS once this date passes, forcing a re-look).

entries.reason: Dev-only. eslint, @eslint/config-array and @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree pin minimatch 10.2.6; the fix is 11.0.1 (ESM-only) with no 10.x backport and npm reports no fix available. Globs are fixed repository lint patterns, not attacker input.
